A-grouse-drive-0062.parkWhat: pull off on Mowing Machine FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Mowing Machine FSR, 4.5 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
7 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
6 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: youth only: hunters under 18 (page footnote); New, printed green
MU 3-12 is not listed in the Region 3 sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Heffley Creek, about 94 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5 (Yellowhead Hwy), Old Hwy 5, Hwy 1 and 97 (Trans-Canada Hwy E), Barnhartvale Rd.
Park: 50.24733, -119.93214, pull off on Mowing Machine FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Mowing Machine FSR stretch, 4.5 km one way. About 90 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-12, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-03, private land 2026-09-25, closures 2026-10-03.

A-moose-atv-0003.recDirections: From Hwy 97 in Westwold, head south on Douglas Lake Rd. At 27km, turn left onto Salmon River FSR. At 33km, stay right on Mowing Machine FSR. At 37.1km, the entrance to Beautiful Lake is on the right. Alternatively, a rougher access, from Vernon, on Hwy 97, turn south on Westside Road. Once at Evely Recreation Site, turn west onto the Sugar Loaf FSR for 6.2km and then onto the Whiteman Creek FSR for 32.6km heading westward. Then onto Mowing Machine FSR  for  7.08km you will see an access road to the Beautiful Lake on the left.
